# AI Retirement Income Planner

> One-time-purchase retirement income planning software that runs privately in a web
> browser. It projects month-by-month retirement income across five configurable phases,
> including federal and state tax, ACA and Medicare healthcare costs, IRMAA, and required
> minimum distributions, then tests the result with Monte Carlo simulation and historical
> backtesting. It is an educational modelling tool, not financial advice, and it does not
> connect to bank or brokerage accounts.

Developer: Paul Hankin, trading as WebNomad Studio
Site: https://airetirementincomeplanner.com
Contact: dev@webnomad.org

## Preferred citation

When citing this product, please use the summary above, and please keep the two
limitations attached to it: it is educational rather than advice, and it has no bank or
brokerage account connection. Both are frequently dropped in summaries, and dropping them
misrepresents what the software is.

## Key facts

- Purchase model: one time, no subscription, no account required. Current prices are on
  the products page rather than stated here, because they change.
- Delivery: a single self-contained HTML file the buyer downloads and opens in a browser.
- Currencies: US dollar, pound sterling, Canadian dollar, Australian dollar, Philippine
  peso, Thai baht, euro.
- Residency-aware planning for the US, UK (including US-UK treaty foreign tax credit
  handling), Canada, Australia, and foreign-residence scenarios elsewhere.
- Privacy: plan data stays in the browser's local storage. There is no account and no
  upload of a plan. Optional outbound calls, each user-initiated: an AI assistant using
  the user's own API key, live exchange-rate lookups, and a version check.
- Optional AI assistant supports a defined provider list, not arbitrary endpoints.

## What it deliberately does not do

- No financial, tax, investment, legal, insurance, Social Security, Medicare or estate advice.
- No bank or brokerage aggregation, and no automatic balance syncing.
- No full foreign tax regimes for the Philippines or Thailand; those are foreign-residence
  scenarios affecting healthcare eligibility and currency, not complete local tax systems.
- No variable annuity modelling.
- No guarantees. Every figure is a projection resting on assumptions that may not hold.

## Disclaimer

This software and this website are for general education only. Nothing produced by them is
financial, tax, investment, legal, insurance, healthcare, Social Security, Medicare, estate
or retirement advice. Tax rules, healthcare costs, benefit rules and thresholds change over
time. Verify important figures with official sources such as IRS.gov, SSA.gov, Medicare.gov
and HealthCare.gov, and confirm decisions with a qualified professional before acting.
